title: CRL delta entries cloned unnecessarily in verify_delta_crl_and_collect
description:
In pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs lines 1070-1083, verify_delta_crl_and_collect clones the entire delta CRL revoked-certificates Vec on every check_revocation call. The comment acknowledges this ('Deferred as a low-priority perf cleanup') and notes a borrow-based design returning Option<&[RevokedCert]> is feasible now that delta_crl is borrowed from self.delta_crl.

What goes wrong: For CRLs with large revoked-certificate lists, every call to check_revocation pays an O(N) clone of the delta entries. In a batch-validation scenario (AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6), this becomes O(certs * delta_entries).

Locations:
- pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:1070-1083 (verify_delta_crl_and_collect return)
- pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:648 (call site in check_revocation)
- pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:842 (call site in check_revocation_against_anchor)

Recommendation: Change verify_delta_crl_and_collect to return a borrowed slice, updating check_revocation_status_indirect to accept &[RevokedCert] (which it already does).
